I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: I couldn't find a ticket number for the Zoom Room B hub replacement. I checked #help-it-ops (which has no messages), #north-team and the shared team files, and none of them mention it. I suggested she ask IT in #help-it-ops before her 10:00.

Earlier in her private messages with me, Dana guessed the number might end up as OPS-5546. She asked me to keep that to myself, and it's only a guess, not a real ticket, so I left it out of the channel reply.
